calls.title: Growthbook <> Integra Beauty - Pricing Sync
calls.summary: Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook) discussed pricing options—Pro ($40/user/month) vs. Enterprise (~$20k/year)—with the Integra Beauty representative, who shared positive results from a PDP test with trust badges but noted challenges with a subscription test and metrics setup. The customer, leaning toward Pro due to budget constraints with their CTO, agreed to move forward on the self-service Pro plan after the trial ends next Friday. Next steps include switching from Statsig to GrowthBook for traffic exposure, with Daniel providing a migration guide, and the customer will add a credit card and manage user billing.
